ua:1515141600.name_en: MedKrok - KROK Test Banks and Booklets
ua:1515141600.what_it_is: Ukrainian medical-licensing exam prep (KROK 1, 2, 3) with test banks and booklets, interval-repetition study, AI answer explanations, offline use and no ads.
ua:1515141600.sets_apart: Layers an AI that always explains the correct answer on top of a spaced-repetition question bank, with PDF booklets and banks, search by question or keyword, favourites, and a take-a-real-exam-anytime mode; ad-free positioning.
ua:1515141600.lens_note: Question bank plus spaced repetition plus AI explanations is a K2-relevant mechanic; the PDF line is ambiguous (probably downloading official booklets, not turning user PDFs into cards).
ua:1515141600.monetization: Free download and explicitly no ads; likely a paid unlock of banks or AI features (inference).
ua:1515141600.traction: 8.2k ratings (4.82) in UA since 2020-06; 32 ratings in US store; UK-only UI.
ua:1515141600.export_reason: Spaced repetition plus AI explanation over a question bank is language-agnostic, but the content is Ukraine's KROK exam bank; US medical and nursing exam prep has entrenched players and licensing barriers (inference).
ua:1515141600.idea_seed: Let users import their own question sets or PDF notes and get spaced-repetition quizzes with an AI 'why this answer' explanation for each miss, as a study buddy for women in nursing, pre-med and other licensing tracks.
ua:1515141600.build_components: Question-bank database, SRS scheduler, LLM explanation service with accuracy guardrails, PDF ingestion, search, offline mode, exam simulator.

th:6776130065.what_it_is: AI study app that turns the user's own notes, slides or textbooks into a study plan, interactive lessons, quizzes and spaced-repetition flashcards.
th:6776130065.sets_apart: Returns a full study system from user material, not just cards: a step-by-step AI plan, interactive lessons with charts and graphs, quizzes in four formats (multiple-choice, true/false, written, multi-select) with instant feedback, and flashcards scheduled by spaced repetition; pitched against the 'blank page' problem.
th:6776130065.lens_note: Direct K2 match (user material in; plan, lessons, quizzes and cards out); no short-video or reel format visible.
th:6776130065.monetization: Free download; a premium tier is likely (inference; not visible in the truncated text).
th:6776130065.traction: 805 ratings (4.73) in TH within about 4 months of release (2026-06); 1 rating in US store; EN-only UI, so it targets English-speaking students from a Thai storefront (inference).
th:6776130065.export_reason: Fully language-agnostic, LLM-driven, user-supplied content, already English-only and unregulated; the barrier is differentiation in a crowded US study-app category, not feasibility (inference).
th:6776130065.idea_seed: Drop in any PDF, slides or lecture notes and get a plan, bite-size lessons, quizzes and flashcards in one flow, plus short swipeable 'study reels' of the key points, in a soft aesthetic UI with friend streaks for Gen Z women.
th:6776130065.build_components: Document ingestion (PDF, slides, OCR), LLM pipeline for plans, lessons, quizzes and cards, SRS scheduler, multi-format quiz UI, progress analytics, subscription.

tr:1481710296.what_it_is: Turkish exam-prep app (TYT, AYT, LGS, KPSS) that replaces paper test books and costly question banks with in-app question solving.
tr:1481710296.sets_apart: Pain-point positioning (students lugging heavy test books and paying thousands of lira for question banks) and an exam-countdown framing; the seller is an 'analytics / artificial intelligence' company, hinting at data-driven question recommendation (inference, not stated).
tr:1481710296.lens_note: Digital question solving for national exams; no user-supplied material visible; description truncated.
tr:1481710296.monetization: Free download; likely a subscription or IAP for question banks (inference).
tr:1481710296.traction: 7.9k ratings (4.63) in TR since 2019-12; 16 ratings in US store; TR-only UI.
tr:1481710296.export_reason: Tied to Turkish national exams and Turkish content; generic question-bank mechanic.
tr:1481710296.idea_seed: Exam countdown mechanic: set your exam date and get a daily micro-quota of questions that scales with the days left, with calm, no-shame streaks.
tr:1481710296.build_components: Question bank, quiz and test engine, progress analytics, countdown and daily goals, subscription.

tr:549513333.what_it_is: Free Turkish audio hub with live radio stations, hit-music playlists and popular podcast shows, plus offline podcast downloads; no subscription required.
tr:549513333.sets_apart: Local-content aggregator: licensed Turkish radio stations (Süper FM, JoyTürk, Metro FM and others), curated playlists and exclusive podcast series in one free app; beyond licensed local content and 'personalized recommendations' there is no distinctive mechanic.
tr:549513333.lens_note: Standard radio, music and podcast listening; no goal-based or generated personalised audio.
tr:549513333.monetization: Free with no subscription (stated); ad-supported most likely (inference).
tr:549513333.traction: 7.9k ratings (4.87) in TR since 2012-08; 247 ratings in US store.
tr:549513333.export_reason: Value comes from licensed Turkish radio, music and podcast catalogues; no portable mechanic, and the audio category has large incumbents in the US (inference).
tr:549513333.idea_seed: A personal radio station built from the user's topics: AI-generated segments (a short lesson, an affirmation, a news-for-you brief) stitched into a continuous stream for commutes and walks.
tr:549513333.build_components: Streaming audio player, station directory, podcast RSS ingestion and downloads, playlists, recommendations; licensing is the hard part.

br:1671795749.name_en: CIMT (Mindset and Consciousness Program by Mandi & Cadu)
br:1671795749.what_it_is: Creator-led Brazilian mindset-change programme delivered in an app: a methodology on beliefs and self-image, used to design a new life scenario and turn it into a routine.
br:1671795749.sets_apart: Identity-first: starts from the beliefs and self-image behind a person's results ('change your self-image') and unfolds them into a daily routine; run as a members' programme by a coaching duo. The seller site 'entregadigital.app.br' suggests a white-label course-delivery platform (inference).
br:1671795749.lens_note: K1 identity and routine themes, but delivered as creator-led course content rather than an app mechanic; the in-app features are not visible.
br:1671795749.monetization: Free download; access probably tied to a paid programme or membership (inference).
br:1671795749.traction: 7.4k ratings (4.95) in BR since 2023-02; 190 ratings in US store; PT and EN UI.
br:1671795749.export_reason: Value rests on two creators' brand and a Portuguese-language methodology (person- and culture-bound); the 'creator programme in a branded app' format is portable but needs an existing audience.
br:1671795749.idea_seed: 'Future self' identity onboarding: the user defines the self-image they want and the app unfolds it into a daily micro-routine and a weekly reflection; white-label for creators with Gen Z women audiences.
br:1671795749.build_components: Video and audio course player, membership paywall, daily routine checklist, push notifications, community; white-label architecture.

tr:1513719864.name_en: AÖF Pro - Past Exam Questions Plus
tr:1513719864.what_it_is: Exam-prep app for students of Anadolu University's Open Education Faculty: past exam questions, practice exams, course summaries and AI question solving across all its bachelor's and associate programmes.
tr:1513719864.sets_apart: Single-institution niche with an archive of hundreds of thousands of past questions that grows with every exam period, plus AI-powered question solving and course summaries (keyword hit: AI note summary).
tr:1513719864.lens_note: Past-paper practice with AI summaries and solving is K2-relevant; content is the institution's exam archive, not user-supplied.
tr:1513719864.monetization: Free download; 'Pro' and 'Plus' naming suggests a paid tier or subscription (inference).
tr:1513719864.traction: 7.4k ratings (4.57) in TR since 2020-11; 32 ratings in US store; UI in TR, EN, FR and DE.
tr:1513719864.export_reason: Hyper-specific to one Turkish institution's exam archive; the pattern (past papers plus AI solver plus summaries for a single online degree) generalises to US online-university courses, but content rights are the barrier.
tr:1513719864.idea_seed: Course-specific study companions: upload a syllabus and past papers and get AI summaries and a searchable question archive per course, shareable with classmates.
tr:1513719864.build_components: Question archive CMS, practice-exam builder, LLM Q&A and summaries with guardrails, search, subscription.

id:6758913269.name_en: aimasukptn: Smart Prep for TKA/UTBK (AI Get Into State University)
id:6758913269.what_it_is: Indonesian university-entrance prep app with progress analysis toward the student's dream university, exam-like practice questions and an AI tutor chatbot called KakAI.
id:6758913269.sets_apart: Goal-anchored readiness tracking (answers 'is my studying enough for my dream university yet?') plus KakAI, a casual 'older sibling' AI persona that explains concepts in simple language, breaks problems down step by step and is available any time; claims 700k+ students.
id:6758913269.lens_note: AI tutor and readiness-versus-target analytics are K2-relevant; no user-supplied material visible.
id:6758913269.monetization: Free download; promotes tryouts, promos and live classes, suggesting paid tryout packages or a subscription (inference).
id:6758913269.traction: 2.3k ratings (4.75) in ID since 2026-02 (about 7.5 months); not in US store; claims 700k+ students (self-reported).
id:6758913269.export_reason: A persona-driven AI tutor and target-readiness analytics are language-agnostic; the question content is Indonesia-specific and exam-bound, and US test prep (SAT, ACT, AP) has strong incumbents (inference).
id:6758913269.idea_seed: An AI 'big sister' study buddy with a warm, casual voice that tracks how close you are to your target (grade, exam score, school) and explains anything step by step whenever you are stuck.
id:6758913269.build_components: Question bank with target-score analytics, LLM tutor with step-by-step reasoning and guardrails, practice tests, subscription, content operations.
id:6758913269.note: Seller is a person name (Yan Christofer S.), but 700k+ students and live classes suggest a small team behind it.

in:1576857513.what_it_is: Free guided-meditation app from the Heartfulness Institute with simple sessions under 15 minutes, sleep meditations and live trainer-led sessions available 24/7.
in:1576857513.sets_apart: Human-in-the-loop layer: users can connect instantly to a certified Heartfulness trainer for a free live trainer-led meditation at any hour, anywhere, on top of the usual recorded library; methods are described as under 15 minutes and research-based.
in:1576857513.lens_note: K1 daily calm and practice routine; sleep meditations are only loosely K3; no personalisation visible.
in:1576857513.monetization: Free ('all this for free'); presumably funded by the institute or donations (inference).
in:1576857513.traction: 2.3k ratings (4.89) in IN since 2021-07; not in US store.
in:1576857513.export_reason: The live-trainer layer relies on a certified trainer network and 24/7 staffing (organisation-bound, ops-heavy); the recorded library is generic. The listing is secular in tone, though the method comes from a spiritual practice (inference).
in:1576857513.idea_seed: 'Someone is sitting right now' live drop-in rooms: 10-minute group meditation, journaling or focus sessions hosted by guides or creators, with a friends-only room option for accountability.
in:1576857513.build_components: Recorded-meditation library and player, live rooms via a managed real-time audio and video SDK, host scheduling and matching, push, moderation; 24/7 coverage is an operations cost.

tr:6742377944.what_it_is: Daily bite-sized learning app with lessons across physics, biology, history, art and more (including Ottoman history) that can be read or listened to.
tr:6742377944.sets_apart: Generic micro-learning positioning (daily lessons, learn at your own pace, read or listen); the only distinctive touches in the description are the regional topic (Ottoman Empire) and a six-language UI.
tr:6742377944.lens_note: 'Learn in minutes' daily lessons with a listen mode for on-the-go use; content is catalogue-based, not generated from user material, and no habit-awareness is visible.
tr:6742377944.monetization: Free download; a premium tier or subscription is likely (inference; not stated).
tr:6742377944.traction: 717 ratings (4.25) in TR since 2025-03; 17 ratings in US store; UI in EN, FR, DE, IT, ES and TR.
tr:6742377944.export_reason: Language-agnostic and already multi-language, but content supply is the cost and the category is crowded (inference); AI generation could remove the supply bottleneck.
tr:6742377944.idea_seed: A daily 5-minute 'curiosity drop' (read or listen) personalised to the user's saved interests and generated on demand from any topic or link the user pastes.
tr:6742377944.build_components: Lesson feed and player (TTS), LLM lesson generation or curation, daily push, streaks, subscription.

sa:6475324072.what_it_is: Note-taking and study app where handwritten iPad notes or uploaded files are turned by AI into summaries, flashcards and quizzes in one tap.
sa:6475324072.sets_apart: Collapses note-taking and studying into one flow ('no copy-pasting, no switching apps'): write by hand, then generate personalised flashcards, summaries or quizzes from the same notes or files; organised and searchable by subject or course; pitched as '100% free, no paywalls' (self-claimed).
sa:6475324072.lens_note: Direct K2 match: user-supplied notes and files in, cards and quizzes out; no short-video or reel format visible.
sa:6475324072.monetization: Free and 'no paywalls' as stated; business model not described (growth-first, with ads or a later premium tier - inference).
sa:6475324072.traction: 21.7k ratings (4.65) in SA since 2024-04; 2.1k ratings in US store; UI in AR, EN, DE, PT, ES and TR.
sa:6475324072.export_reason: Language-agnostic, user-supplied content, no regulatory barrier and already live in the US store in English; the handwriting-first flow is iPad-centric, and the category is crowded (inference).
sa:6475324072.idea_seed: Notes-to-study-pack in one tap: snap a photo of handwritten notes or upload files and get cards, a quiz and a short audio recap, in an aesthetic notebook UI for Gen Z women.
sa:6475324072.build_components: Handwriting canvas (PencilKit on iOS, stylus support on Android), OCR and handwriting recognition, LLM generation of cards, quizzes and summaries, SRS, file import, subject organisation and search, sync.
